tools.name: browser_click
tools.description: Perform click on a web page

ref.description: Exact element reference from the latest snapshot

tools.name: browser_clipboard_write
tools.description: Write text to the browser clipboard

text.description: Text to write to the clipboard

tools.name: browser_close_tab
tools.description: Close a browser tab by its tab ID

tabId.description: Numeric ID of the tab to close

tools.name: browser_delete_cookie
tools.description: Delete a specific browser cookie by name

name.description: Name of the cookie to delete

url.description: Cookie URL (accepted for compatibility; deletion uses the active page)

tools.name: browser_dialog_handle
tools.description: Handle a JavaScript dialog (alert, confirm, or prompt) by accepting or dismissing it

promptText.description: Text to enter in a prompt dialog

tools.name: browser_drag
tools.description: Perform drag and drop between two elements

startRef.description: Source reference from the latest snapshot

endRef.description: Target reference from the latest snapshot

tools.name: browser_drag_drop
tools.description: Perform a drag-and-drop operation between two elements identified by CSS selectors

sourceSelector.description: CSS selector of the drag source

targetSelector.description: CSS selector of the drop target

tools.name: browser_execute_in_frame
tools.description: Execute JavaScript code inside a specific iframe

frameId.description: Target frame ID, HTML id attribute, or name

code.description: JavaScript expression to evaluate in the frame

tools.name: browser_get_console_logs
tools.description: Get the console logs from the browser

tools.name: browser_get_cookies
tools.description: Get all cookies for a specific URL

url.description: URL whose cookies should be read

tools.name: browser_get_html
tools.description: Get the HTML content of the page or a specific element

selector.description: Target CSS selector (whole page by default)

outerHTML.description: Return outerHTML instead of innerHTML (default: false)

tools.name: browser_get_storage
tools.description: Read localStorage and/or sessionStorage of the active tab

type.description: Storage to read: local, session, or both (default: both)

tools.name: browser_get_text
tools.description: Get the plain text content of the page or a specific element

selector.description: Target CSS selector (whole page by default)

tools.name: browser_go_back
tools.description: Go back to the previous page

tools.name: browser_go_forward
tools.description: Go forward to the next page

tools.name: browser_hover
tools.description: Hover over element on page

ref.description: Exact element reference from the latest snapshot

tools.name: browser_list_tabs
tools.description: List all open browser tabs with their IDs, URLs, and titles

tools.name: browser_navigate
tools.description: Navigate to a URL

tools.name: browser_network_clear
tools.description: Clear the captured network buffer without stopping an active capture.

tabId.description: Tab to capture or inspect (active tab by default).

tools.name: browser_network_detail
tools.description: Read a captured request including headers, query URL, POST data, response body, timing, errors and WebSocket frames. Bodies can be unavailable or truncated; see bodyError and truncated fields.

tabId.description: Tab to capture or inspect (active tab by default).

tools.name: browser_network_export_har
tools.description: Export captured traffic as HAR 1.2. Returns HAR JSON, or writes a new file on the MCP server machine if filePath is supplied. Existing files are not overwritten. Timing phases are aggregated; unavailable fields use HAR sentinel values.

tabId.description: Tab to capture or inspect (active tab by default).

filePath.description: Optional output .har file path on the MCP server machine

tools.name: browser_network_list
tools.description: List captured requests with IDs, URLs, methods, statuses, durations and failures. Supports filters and pagination. Use the returned id in browser_network_detail.

tabId.description: Tab to capture or inspect (active tab by default).

resourceType.description: Resource type filter, e.g. Fetch, XHR, Document, WebSocket

tools.name: browser_network_start
tools.description: Start network capture on a tab. Captures future HTTP requests, responses, failures and WebSocket messages. Reload the page afterwards to capture initial loading. Starting an already active capture preserves it; starting a stopped capture resets its buffer.

tabId.description: Tab to capture or inspect (active tab by default).

captureBodies.description: Collect response bodies (default: true). Text is capped at 262144 characters per response, with 8388608 characters shared by response bodies and WebSocket frames.

maxEntries.description: Maximum retained requests (1000 by default). Oldest requests are evicted.

tools.name: browser_network_stop
tools.description: Stop capture and release the debugger. Recorded requests and captured bodies remain available until clear, restart or extension reload.

tabId.description: Tab to capture or inspect (active tab by default).

tools.name: browser_new_tab
tools.description: Open a new browser tab, optionally navigating to a URL

tools.name: browser_press_key
tools.description: Press a key on the keyboard

key.description: Key name, e.g. ArrowLeft, Enter, a

tools.name: browser_reload
tools.description: Reload the current browser page, optionally with a hard refresh (cache bypass)

hard.description: Bypass the cache when reloading (default: false)

tools.name: browser_screenshot
tools.description: Take a screenshot of the current page

tools.name: browser_screenshot_element
tools.description: Take a screenshot of a specific DOM element identified by a CSS selector

selector.description: CSS selector of the target element

tools.name: browser_screenshot_fullpage
tools.description: Capture a full-page screenshot (beyond the visible viewport)

tools.name: browser_scroll
tools.description: Scroll the page or a specific element to given coordinates or into view

selector.description: CSS selector to scroll into view (takes priority over x/y)

tools.name: browser_select_option
tools.description: Select an option in a dropdown

ref.description: Exact element reference from the latest snapshot

tools.name: browser_set_cookie
tools.description: Set or update a browser cookie

httpOnly.description: HttpOnly flag (currently not supported by the document.cookie setter)

expires.description: Expiry as a Unix timestamp in seconds

tools.name: browser_snapshot
tools.description: Capture accessibility snapshot of the current page. Use this for getting references to elements to interact with.

tools.name: browser_switch_tab
tools.description: Switch to a specific browser tab by its tab ID

tabId.description: Numeric ID of the tab to activate

tools.name: browser_type
tools.description: Type text into editable element

ref.description: Exact element reference from the latest snapshot

submit.description: Submit the associated form after typing

tools.name: browser_upload_file
tools.description: Upload a file to a file input element on the page

selector.description: CSS selector of an input[type=file] element

filePath.description: Absolute or relative local path of the file to upload

tools.name: browser_wait
tools.description: Wait for a specified time in seconds

tools.name: execute_script
tools.description: Execute arbitrary JavaScript code in the active browser tab and return the result

world.description: Execution world hint (currently accepted but not enforced)
